associations.name: Walla Walla
associations.period: Historical regional life described before the early 1900s; geography passage inspected 2026-10-21
associations.evidenceNote: The CTUIR history's Life cycle and Foods section explicitly places the three constituent peoples, including Walla Walla, primarily in southeastern Washington and its neighboring cross-border region. Its lower-Columbia account separately identifies Walla Walla river communities and bands. This is a broad historical connection, not presence everywhere in the state or a merged Cayuse/Umatilla/Walla Walla identity. This supplied-study URL was independently read.

associations.name: Mohegan
associations.evidenceNote: The Mohegan Tribe's Sachem Uncas page explicitly identifies its reservation in southeastern Connecticut. Only this geographical statement is used here, not the page's interpretation of seventeenth-century alliances. Mohegan is not treated as interchangeable with Mohican or Pequot.

associations.name: Musqueam
associations.period: Community territory account and 1976 declaration; inspected 2026-10-21
associations.evidenceNote: Musqueam's own territory page describes ancestors throughout the Fraser River estuary and identifies modern Vancouver and neighboring municipalities within the territory. The same page locates its Band in Vancouver, BC. This regional index does not reproduce the declaration as a polygon, adjudicate title or imply all British Columbia is Musqueam territory.

associations.name: Nisga'a
associations.associationType: Present specific government and community region
associations.evidenceNote: Actual Nisga’a Lisims Government page text identifies the Nisga’a relationship with the Nass River Valley and gives the government location in New Aiyansh, BC. This is a specific community/government route, not a full homeland polygon or a review of treaty terms. The inspected geographical paragraph and government-location text, rather than the bare homepage title, support this map connection; no speaker figures used.

associations.name: Manzanita Kumeyaay
associations.associationType: Present specific community and reservation location
associations.evidenceNote: The Southern California Tribal Chairmen's Association locates the Manzanita Reservation in southeastern San Diego County, California, and identifies its members as part of the Kumeyaay Nation. This supports Manzanita specifically, without assigning every broader Kumeyaay homeland association to this individual band. Officeholder names and historical acreage are not adopted as current verified facts.

associations.name: Nisenan
associations.associationType: Historical and continuing specific community homeland connection
associations.evidenceNote: The Nevada County Library/HUṠWEJ project identifies Nevada City Rancheria Nisenan ancestral and current homelands in northern California. The actual Who are the Nisenan and curriculum passages name California counties and Nevada City/Grass Valley. This record follows the specific community scope; it does not reduce all Nisenan communities to one rancheria, equate Nisenan with all Maidu or make a current federal-recognition claim.

associations.name: Tsawwassen
associations.associationType: Historical and continuing community territory connection
associations.evidenceNote: The actual Our Traditional Territory section identifies lower-Fraser/Salish Sea places including Pitt Meadows, New Westminster and Gulf Islands; Our Future explicitly places the Nation within the Metro Vancouver/BC context. This provides a British Columbia regional connection, not a treaty-land or traditional-territory polygon. Dated March 2019 membership figures and current-law totals were excluded.
